change.title: Open-Meteo Air Quality API — modelled values (CAMS)
change.text: Open-Meteo’s Air Quality API serves forecasts from the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS). Outside Europe it uses the CAMS global model at coarse resolution (tens of kilometres). PM2.5 and the US AQI are computed from modelled concentrations; they are not sensor measurements. Street-level variation, such as traffic or construction dust, is not resolved. Qualité de l’air : valeur de modèle, pas une mesure de capteur.
change.limitations: Modèle à résolution grossière ; ne décrit pas l’exposition au niveau d’une rue.

change.title: CAISO Today’s Outlook — supply by resource type
change.text: CAISO’s Today’s Outlook publishes electricity supply every 5 minutes by resource type (solar, wind, geothermal, biomass, biogas, small hydro, coal, nuclear, natural gas, large hydro, batteries, imports, other), in megawatts (MW), for the CAISO balancing authority area, which covers most of California. Battery values are negative while charging. The figures describe the state grid zone, not San Francisco’s own consumption, and are operational data that may be revised.
change.limitations: Échelle de l’État ; pas de lien direct avec un tronçon ou un bâtiment.

change.title: CORE simulation integrity rules
change.text: In CORE only validated deterministic models produce modelled numbers: coordination-schedule-v1, tree-proximity-exposure-v1 and evidence-completeness-v1. Agents, including model-assisted agents, may propose parameters within bounded ranges: tree radius 5–30 m, frontage 20–80 m, horizon 30–120 days, deferral 7–60 days, building recency 90–730 days. The deterministic investigation computes the results and the gateway recomputes them. A language model never produces simulation outputs or other numbers; it can only make a decision more cautious by requesting evidence. No traffic, energy or ecological model is calibrated.
change.confidence: règle de conception CORE (vérifiée par tests)
change.limitations: Règle interne ; ne valide pas les modèles eux-mêmes.
